args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. SRE rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production, across all regions. Post-rollback verification shows v2.3.0 healthy in all three regions with error rate 0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still under investigation; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until fixed.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** The latest deploy, `checkout-api` v2.3.1, was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was only validated in staging, not production).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all three production regions — rollback confirmed rolled out.
2. **Verified recovery:** the service is now healthy in all regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failure and rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unknown, so the incident remains open for investigation. Also, per policy, redeploying v2.3.1 will require change-manager approval since it was never healthy in production.
